name: Vesper Somatics
summary: Biotech: grows soldiers, treats the Bloom as a resource. Clean labs, filthy ethics.
oversightStyle: Approves Leash requests readily when the paperwork is clean; treats the CCP as a living test bed.

name: Kestrel-Ward Industrial
summary: Heavy industry and cybernetics: more metal than flesh, brutal efficiency, quotas.
oversightStyle: Approves Leash requests against quota shortfalls; treats the CCP as a labour pool.

name: Aurum Concord
summary: Finance and logistics; owns the debt of everyone else.
oversightStyle: Faction only in v1: approves anything that can be invoiced.

name: Sable Line
summary: Security contractor; the corporation corporations hire to clean up.
oversightStyle: Faction only in v1: deniable, expensive, quick.
